newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME RISE.

text.p: Turnover rose to 200,790 denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange from 151,320 denars on Thursday as only one company traded, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold 207 shares at 970 denars, unchanged from Thursday's close and below par of 2,424 denars.
Traded volume was 156 stocks at the previous session when only Alkaloid shares traded.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
